'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Wall LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Wall]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' w@nd3r-b0b
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
